svg.text: Dual-layered document database: Virtual abstraction over logical storage partitions
Buffer Fix: Treats HTTP content as binary data (not C strings)
Enterprise-grade RBAC with JWT authentication and field-level security
Checkpoint-based allocation with automatic cleanup and thread-local stacks
Unified abstraction: All entities appear as documents via virtual collections
Separate logical areas: Documents, JS Scripts, JS Bytecode, Versions, Configurations
High-performance JDBX binary format with Write-Ahead Logging and CRC32 integrity
